title: OJI’AD’s “Wasting Time” is a bold new track that redefines genre boundaries
htmlContent: In the midst of a bland music culture, OJI'AD's "Wasting Time" featuring AL-B OnceAgain, is an example of originality and skill. This track is a master class in versatility, merging singing, songwriting, and rap with an effortless grace that few artists dare even to dream of. "Wasting Time" is the rare song that sucks you in because of OJI'AD's raw delivery. The song excels in its seamlessly merging styles. OJI'AD doesn't simply switch between singing and rapping but rather forms a seamless narrative between catchy hooks and aggressive verses. This rare combination presents an artist who knows as much about the power of stories as he does the concept of music itself. "Wasting Time" relates to anyone who has spiraled into indecision and emotional limbo moments. It's an idea anyone can relate to, but OJI'AD raises it a level by encapsulating those feelings in wordplay. The songwriting process is still thoughtful, yet it's not overly complicated, meaning the song remains approachable but has depth. What sets "Wasting Time" apart is OJI'AD's fearless genre-blending. The rapped parts land with crisp, confident assurance, and the sung parts have a melodic softness that blends gorgeously. Instead of the worlds, it references, feeling like two separate entities crashing into each other on the track, it has a sense of unity driven by OJI'AD's dynamic vocal range and sense of timing. https://open.spotify.com/track/6Z4BzZLQZkMFGVxJc0aedy The sound works in complement to this duality, it's clean, balanced, and contemporary, giving the vocals the space to take over without competing for attention. Every beat and choice of instrument feels weighed and intentional, serving the song's mood and message instead of burying it. "Wasting Time" proves that versatility doesn't have to equal sell-out, and true artist resides where different sounds meet. For fans of both soulful and visibly lyric-driven music, you're in for a treat. In a time when time is precious, OJI'AD's "Wasting Time" shows us why it's worth investing in music.
